provider.cron.name: CRON Schedule
provider.cron.desc: Triggers a generation on a CRON schedule.
provider.cron.expr_hint: Standard 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday. Supports *, ranges (a-b), lists (,) and steps (/n). E.g.: 0 9 * * * = daily at 9:00; */30 * * * * = every 30 minutes.
provider.cron.trigger_text_hint: Message text written to the chat as System when triggered. Leave empty to skip.
api_config.profiles_hint: Store multiple embedding service profiles and switch the active one at any time. Memory indexes are built per profile and are not rebuilt automatically on switch.
api_config.empty: No profile yet. Add your first embedding service profile below.
api_config.name: Profile name
api_config.switch_hint: After switching the active profile, memory uses the matching model index; build it in Memory & Vector Store if it is missing.
api_config.load_error: Embedding profiles could not be loaded: {0}
config_ui.empty_desc: Use “New configuration” above to create your first API configuration.
config_ui.select_desc: Search and switch between configurations. Pinned configurations are listed first.
config_ui.search_placeholder: Search name, type, model, URL, or ID…
config_ui.rename_desc: Give the current configuration a recognizable name.
config_ui.rename_required: The configuration name cannot be empty.
config_ui.delete_desc: This removes the configuration from the current list. The change takes effect after saving.
config_ui.delete_warning: Delete “{0}”? Nodes or agents that reference this configuration ID will no longer resolve it.
api_settings.name: Configuration name
api_settings.name_hint: Shown in the switcher and search dialog. You can also rename it from the toolbar.
api_settings.type_hint: Switching types keeps values already entered for the other types.
api_settings.id_hint: Nodes and agents reference this ID. Cloning generates a new ID.
api_settings.generation_desc: Context length, streaming, and reasoning options.
api_settings.text_completion_desc: Text-completion APIs use these templates to turn chat messages into prompts.
api_settings.fetch_empty: The endpoint returned no usable models.
api_settings.models_loaded: {0} models loaded. Use the dropdown in the model field.
api_settings.gemini.differences: Native Gemini endpoint: thinking cannot be fully disabled, safety filtering is stricter, and prefix continuation is not supported. The always-on hints below list every difference.
api_settings.gemini.thinking_hint: Always shown: Gemini 3 / 4 series cannot disable thinking. For thinkingBudget control on 2.5 series, use the custom request body below.
api_settings.gemini.deprecated_warning: Always shown: temperature / top_p / top_k are ignored by Gemini 4 and 3.6+ (and will error in the future). This client never sends them.
api_settings.gemini.include_thoughts_hin: Always shown: responses include thought summaries, which count toward output tokens. Gemini 3 / 4 always think; this switch only controls summary visibility, not thinking itself. When off, thinking still happens but is entirely invisible.
api_settings.gemini.mid_system_hint: Gemini has no native slot for system fragments that appear mid-conversation: leave empty to fail request building explicitly, or provide a template containing {0} to map them to user turns (each conversion is written to the debug panel).
api_settings.gemini.custom_headers_place:
One Name: Value per line; same-name headers override the default auth header. Example:
Authorization: Bearer proxy-token
config_ui.select_desc_generic: Search and switch between configurations. Pinned configurations are listed first.
config_ui.empty_generic_desc: Use “New configuration” above to create your first configuration.
embedding_config.basic_desc: Profile name, stable ID, and which profile is active.
embedding_config.connection_desc: Endpoint, model, and credentials for the embedding service.
embedding_config.id_hint: Nodes reference this profile by ID; it never changes after creation.
embedding_config.name_hint: Used only to identify this profile in settings.
embedding_config.active_hint: Memory retrieval uses the active profile; save to apply a switch.
embedding_config.active_set: Set “{0}” as active. Save to apply.
embedding_config.empty_desc: Add your first embedding profile to build and search memory indexes.
